finalText:
Builds clean. Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right key.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — strict `=== false`/`=== true` check threw on `undefined`, which is what unset flags come back as now. Fixed to just treat anything not `true` as disabled.

The rest of the noise (DEP01xx/DEP0xx warnings, tree-shaking notes, dedupe lines) is harmless deprecation chatter, left alone.
